lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of high-intensity circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits. The arrangement follows a repeating vertical and horizontal grid with approximately 5-6 spots per vertical column in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance circular blobs, creating a structured grid where the blobs serve as primary nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature with a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient (lighter superiorly, darker inferiorly) runs horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, originating posterior to the dorsal-most gill slit.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 8-12 high-luminance blobs are visible within the submerged and surface-distorted mask of the first dorsal fin, primarily concentrated along the lower two-thirds of the fin's surface area.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density cluster of significantly smaller, concentrated circular pixel motifs is visible on the anterior cranial region. Multiple commensal fish (remoras) are present near the ventral and pectoral regions.
